name: encryptor-mcp
description: Open Cryptomator vaults from Claude: read and write files with the vault's own keys. You unlock vaults yourself on a page in your browser, the password never goes through the chat. Every change can be undone.
long_description:
Open your Cryptomator vaults from Claude Desktop. Claude reads and writes files with the vault's own keys, so they stay encrypted on disk and work in Cryptomator as before.

**You unlock vaults yourself:** when Claude needs a locked vault, a page opens in your browser and you type the password there (on a Mac, a password box can show instead). The password never goes through the chat, and you choose how long the vault stays open. Keys are kept only in memory.

Every change can be undone. Deleting for good only happens when you empty the trash and approve it yourself.

Works with Cryptomator vaults. Not made by or affiliated with Cryptomator.

tools.name: vaults
tools.description: Lists your vaults: open or locked, read only or not, and when an open one locks

tools.name: unlock
tools.description: Asks you to open a locked vault; you type the password on a page, never in the chat

tools.name: lock
tools.description: Locks a vault now, or every open vault, and wipes its keys from memory

tools.name: control_center
tools.description: Opens the control center in your browser: vaults, changes, trash and settings

tools.name: list_folder
tools.description: Lists a folder in an open vault: names, kinds and sizes

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Reads a text file from an open vault

tools.name: file_info
tools.description: Shows a file or folder's kind, size, last change and where it's stored encrypted

tools.name: find
tools.description: Finds files and folders whose name contains some text

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Checks that an open vault's structure is whole, like Cryptomator's own check

tools.name: locate
tools.description: Shows where a file or folder is stored encrypted on disk

tools.name: decrypt_name
tools.description: Gives the real path of an encrypted path inside a vault

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Creates or replaces a text file; the old contents are kept

tools.name: append_file
tools.description: Adds text to the end of a text file

tools.name: make_folder
tools.description: Creates a folder

tools.name: move
tools.description: Moves or renames a file or folder within one vault, never overwriting

tools.name: copy_file
tools.description: Copies a file within a vault, encrypted the whole time

tools.name: trash
tools.description: Puts a file or folder in the vault's trash, where undo can take it back

tools.name: trash_list
tools.description: Lists what's in the vault's trash

tools.name: empty_trash
tools.description: Deletes from the trash for good, after you approve it yourself

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: Lists the latest changes: when, which app, why, and if undone

tools.name: undo
tools.description: Undoes a change, unless the file changed since

tools.name: versions
tools.description: Lists earlier versions of a file

tools.name: restore_version
tools.description: Puts back an earlier version of a file; the current one is kept too

vaults.title: Vaults (optional)
vaults.description: Name=/path/to/vault;Other=/path/to/other. You can leave this empty and add vaults on the control center instead. No passwords here: you type those only on the unlock page.

idle_minutes.title: Lock after minutes without use
idle_minutes.description: An open vault locks by itself after this many minutes without use.
